description.p: Moira displays Claude five-hour and weekly usage plus Codex weekly usage, reset times, optional native and NTFY notifications, a History tab with selectable ranges, exact Codex token statistics, CSV/JSON export, and an Integrations page with a read-only provider/model inventory and capability badges.

Adds the History tab with selectable 24h/7d/30d/90d ranges and per-service filters, quota series with reset transitions, availability states, and exact daily token statistics computed from official Codex account usage (Claude remains percentage-only).

Adds per-provider collection toggles and alert rules, native desktop and NTFY notification channels with deduplicated exhaustion, recovery, reset and error events, compact mode, sanitized diagnostics with copy actions, deterministic CSV/JSON export, history deletion, and manual update checks.

Adds agent activity visibility independent from quotas: a spinner while Claude Code, Hermes or a Moira-owned Codex app-server session works, then a symbolic success/failure/interrupted state for five minutes. Privacy-minimal activity events (hashed session identities, sanitized model labels, UTC timestamps only) are recorded through Moira-owned Claude Code hooks, Hermes shell hooks and the documented Codex app-server protocol, and watched live with no polling or terminal scraping.

Adds a read-only Integrations page with an Agents section and a Providers and models inventory: capability badges per provider and the Hermes main model plus discovered named providers from the installed Hermes CLI, with truthful states — Claude remains percentage-only, unknown balance/cost is never zero, and DeepSeek balance is not configured. An Edit providers view manages local provider profiles (config v4) and per-profile Keyring credentials: remote base URLs require HTTPS and reject loopback (local accepts only loopback), blank input preserves the existing secret, removal is confirmed, writes are recoverable through a durable journal with idempotent recovery at startup and on reload, strict target lookups and no credential loss, and saving other settings never wipes profiles. Hermes writes, connection tests, DeepSeek balance and financial units remain deferred.

Corrects post-reset recovery detection with a pure recovery-transition rule that distinguishes prior weekly exhaustion evidence from current non-exhausted state, enabling recovery events for real post-reset chronology.

Preserves all valid refresh intervals during v1-to-v2 migration, unifies exhaustion semantics between UI and notifications with reset-aware canonical rule, suppresses only the duplicate generic 100% threshold alert, and corrects a French localization typo.

Weekly exhaustion semantics, French localization with English fallback, visible configurable refresh interval, focus-regain refresh, 30-second countdown recompute, and deduplicated exhaustion/recovery NTFY events.
